label: Healthcare advertising
description: Layered on top of the generic set. Blocks outcome and cure claims, which are the primary regulatory exposure in medical advertising.

rules.title: Cure or permanent-fix claims
rules.reason: Claiming to cure, heal, or permanently fix a condition is prohibited in medical advertising in every major jurisdiction.

rules.title: Guaranteed clinical outcomes
rules.reason: No clinical outcome may be guaranteed. Results vary between patients and this cannot be promised.

rules.title: Absolute safety or painlessness claims
rules.reason: No procedure is entirely without risk. Claiming "no risk", "completely safe", or "painless" is a misrepresentation.

rules.title: Results-vary disclaimer
rules.reason: Ads that reference results should carry a statement that outcomes differ between patients.

rules.title: Patient testimonials as evidence
rules.reason: Testimonials presented as typical outcomes are restricted by most regulators. Ensure they are labelled and not presented as representative.

rules.title: Urgency applied to a medical decision
rules.reason: Pressuring someone toward a medical decision with a deadline is prohibited. Health decisions must not be rushed by advertising.
